title: 3 Kesalahan Video Produk HP yang Bikin Orang Tidak Jadi Beli

slides.headline: HP Mahal Tetap Bikin Video Produk Kelihatan Murah?
slides.body: Masalahnya bukan di kualitas kamera HP kamu, tapi 3 kesalahan dasar ini yang sering bikin calon pembeli langsung scroll lewat.
slides.image_prompt: Dark cinematic studio environment showing a high-end smartphone on a mini tripod filming a luxury product, high contrast, warm lighting accent, professional aesthetic, 8k resolution
slides.layout: Hook layout with bold centered headline and dark high-contrast visual background

slides.headline: Kesalahan 1: Lighting Asal-Asalan
slides.body: Mengandalkan lampu kamar bikin produk kusam dan penuh bayangan mengganggu. Gunakan cahaya alami dekat jendela atau softbox mini di samping produk.
slides.image_prompt: Split visual comparison, left side harsh yellow indoor lighting on a product with messy shadows, right side soft diffused window light making the product look glossy and vibrant, clean minimalism
slides.layout: Split-screen comparison layout, bad lighting vs good lighting

slides.headline: Kesalahan 2: Cuma Pakai Satu Angle Statis
slides.body: Video yang cuma diam bikin penonton cepat bosan. Ambil variasi angle: Eye-level untuk impresi awal, Top-down untuk overview, dan Close-up untuk detail.
slides.image_prompt: Grid display showing three distinct camera angles of a sleek product setup: top-down flatlay, eye-level cinematic shot, and extreme close-up on product texture, dark studio vibe
slides.layout: 3-frame grid layout highlighting different video camera angles

slides.headline: Kesalahan 3: Tanpa Visual Hook di 3 Detik Pertama
slides.body: Jangan mulai dengan video kosong atau terlalu lambat. Tunjukkan aksi penggunaan produk atau gerakan dinamis di detik pertama agar penonton bertahan.
slides.image_prompt: Dynamic motion blur effect shot of a hand unboxing a product with glowing neon countdown timer overlay showing 00:03, energetic tech style
slides.layout: Single focal point graphic layout with highlighted text callout box

slides.headline: Solusi: Pakai Formula 4-Shot Sederhana
slides.body:
1. Establishing Shot (Suasana)
2. Medium Shot (Bentuk Produk)
3. Detail Shot (Tekstur/Bahan)
4. Action Shot (Penggunaan)
Video HP kamu otomatis berasa iklan TV!
slides.image_prompt: A clean 4-step storyboard visual flow numbered 1 to 4 showing progressive video shot types for product showcase, sleek UI line art frame elements

slides.headline: Gak Punya Waktu Edit Biar Hasilnya Mewah?
slides.body: Kirim bahan video HP kamu, tim Bos Sony Creative Studio yang akan ubah jadi video jualan berkelas. DM 'EDIT' untuk konsultasi gratis!
slides.image_prompt: Professional video editing suite interface glow background with sleek smartphone mockup showing a high-converting video ad, gold and dark blue branding accents
slides.layout: Call-to-action conversion layout with big offer button graphic and direct instruction
